What is Jasper?

Marketing-focused AI content platform built around brand voice consistency. Jasper learns a company's tone, style guide and product knowledge, then generates on-brand copy across campaigns, channels and formats at team scale.

Best for

Team-scale marketing content that must stay on-brand.

Main features

  • Brand Voice and Style Guide enforcement
  • Knowledge Base of product and company facts
  • Campaigns generating a full multi-channel campaign from one brief
  • 50+ templates
  • Jasper Chat
  • Jasper Art image generation
  • Jasper Studio for custom AI apps
  • browser extension
  • team workspaces with approval workflows
  • analytics.

Practical use cases

  • Producing a full campaign (emails, ads, landing page, social) from a single brief
  • scaling blog production while keeping brand tone
  • localising campaign copy across markets
  • rewriting product descriptions at catalogue scale.

Who is it for?

  • In-house marketing teams, content agencies, enterprise brand and comms teams.

Pricing, free access & limits

Per-seat subscription with tiered feature access

Plans described in the source

Creator around $49/seat/mo ($39 billed annually). Pro around $69/seat/mo ($59 annually) adding multiple brand voices and collaboration. Business/Enterprise quoted annually with SSO, API access, custom workflows and dedicated support - typically five figures per year. Verify - Jasper has repriced and renamed tiers several times.

Free plan

No free plan.

Free trial

Yes - 7-day free trial on self-serve tiers.

Usage limits to consider

Creator is single brand voice and single seat; multiple brand voices, Campaigns and API require higher tiers. Some plans previously had word limits but current tiers are largely unlimited-words with feature gating instead.

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • Brand Voice is the most mature implementation in this category - it materially reduces editing time for teams with a real style guide
  • Campaigns genuinely compress a multi-channel brief into hours
  • solid enterprise governance and approval workflows.

Limitations to consider

  • Expensive per seat relative to using ChatGPT or Claude directly
  • the underlying models are third-party, so raw output quality is not better than the frontier models it wraps
  • value depends entirely on whether you use Brand Voice and Campaigns
  • heavy repricing history makes budgeting uncertain.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Chrome extension, API (enterprise)

Languages

  • 30+ output languages including Arabic and French; interface English

API access

Yes - on Business/Enterprise tiers

Integrations and exports

  • Surfer SEO, Grammarly, Google Docs, Chrome, Webflow, HubSpot, Zapier, Google Ads, Meta Ads

Evaluation notes

The honest test is whether your team will actually maintain the Brand Voice and Knowledge Base - unmaintained, Jasper is an expensive wrapper. Teams of one rarely justify the cost over a $20 frontier assistant.
